vu1029a.title: Sony HXR-NX30J NXCAM Full HD Camcorder with XLR Handle Unit Charger and Remote
vu1029a.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vu1029a.details: Sony HXR-NX30J NXCAM Full HD camcorder in black, with a Carl Zeiss Vario-Sonnar T* lens, 10x optical zoom, an Exmor R CMOS sensor and Balanced Optical SteadyShot. Condition: there are scuffs and scratches from use, as shown in the photos. There is some dust in the optics, but no mold or haze that affects shooting, and the view is clear. Operation was checked and works. Included, as shown in the first photo: the camcorder, a Sony XLR handle unit with a shoe adapter, a battery pack, a battery charger, a remote control, an AV cable, a USB cable and a USB conversion cable. Please check the photos for the exact condition and the included items.
